RNG: same seeded native construction/reset/wrap and ambient post-wrap streams across conditions; identical pass opportunities/order; checkpoint all Python/NumPy/Torch CPU/selected CUDA state; no per-pass reseed; graph-induced differences disclosed
accumulation_equivalence: pending admitted numerical test; fp32 summation order need not be bitwise equal to a summed-loss tape
attribution: Fixed graph-view diversification and shared parameter ensembles are known baselines; no new mechanism or novelty claim.
backward: each CE/4 backward immediately; zero once; one Adam step after all eight backward passes; pre-step parameters unchanged
checkpoint_storage: strict-improvement state held on CPU; save selected-local at transition and final selected state; retain all trace selection events; no promise of binary reopening every transient improvement
final: restore overall selected state and exact stage, including local winner; fixed arithmetic mean of four class-softmax probability vectors
freeze_prerequisites: Real official TRAIN-only coverage saved and hash-bound before freezing; fixtures excluded.
Numerical synthetic state/function/accumulation/replay tests after root admission.
Explicit frozen block, seeds, features, validation targets, views and all four conditions.
Competent same-label-budget single/conventional ensemble controls and confirmation history specified separately before scientific quality claims.
objective: sum over four members of [CE(native,TRAIN)+CE(assigned view,TRAIN)] / 4
reporting: VAL exploratory pooled accuracy/NLL/macro-F1 and member accuracy/NLL; TRAIN metrics are fitted-function diagnostics

role_visibility.fit: all official TRAIN IDs and labels
role_visibility.test: mask IDs only; no TEST labels or reader
role_visibility.validation: strict pooled accuracy selector and exploratory selected-checkpoint reporting only
role_visibility.views: both endpoints TRAIN only; fixed labels once before fitting

schedule: shuffled 2-of-4 hash assignment followed by complement per two updates, restarted at each even-length stage; all assignments source-bound by schedule digest; persistent members0,1 equal and2,3 different
selection: one strict pooled native-graph VALIDATION correct-count best across actual updates1..2700, earliest ties; no epoch0
transition: after actual200 restore selected-local model and Adam; retain live actual clock and live RNG; set every core global=true
unsupported: Dataset acquisition/import and role-label projection provenance are caller responsibilities; no data loader is included.
Modern single and conventional independently initialized controls are not implemented in this four-bank patch.
No HPO, production release, server entry point, resource admission, paired outcome synthesis or confirmation/TEST endpoint is supplied.
